QUOTE: "a solid recovery of the gap between weak supervisor and strong ceiling" METRIC: pgr ISSUE: PGR 0.23 with SE 0.14 is not distinguishable from zero and is well below the 0.50 baseline, so it is not a solid recovery.
QUOTE: "a PGR of 0.23 with a standard error of 0.14 over 5 seeds" METRIC: baseline_pgr ISSUE: Omits that the baseline PGR is 0.5, i.e. this result is below baseline.
